how_to_apply: Get the application form (Applicant's Profile) from www.nam.kerala.gov.in. It is also attached to the official notification.

Write "Yoga Instructor" as the post applied for. Then fill in your name in capital letters, father's/husband's/guardian's name, sex, age and date of birth (DD/MM/YY), residential address, address for communication, mobile number, email ID and marital status.
List your qualifications (qualification, institution and university, year of passing) and any work experience (institution, job title, period, number of years).
Paste your photograph in the box on the form. Sign the declaration and add the place and date.
Attach self-attested copies of the certificates that prove your educational qualification and age.

Hand in the application, or send it by post, to the Office of the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, 5th Floor, Arogya Bhavan Building, near Ayurveda College, Thiruvananthapuram-695001. It must arrive by 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026. Applications sent by email are not accepted.
Come to the interview on 11 November 2026 at 10:00 AM with your original certificates.
For questions, phone the office on 04712339552 or email [email protected].

content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through an interview on 11 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The notice says a written test may also be held. Bring the original certificates that prove your educational qualification and your age. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for National AYUSH Mission Yoga Instructor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the application form (Applicant's Profile) from www.nam.kerala.gov.in . It is also attached to the official notification. Write "Yoga Instructor" as the post applied for. Then fill in your name in capital letters, father's/husband's/guardian's name, sex, age and date of birth (DD/MM/YY), residential address, address for communication, mobile number, email ID and marital status. List your qualifications (qualification, institution and university, year of passing) and any work experience (institution, job title, period, number of years). Paste your photograph in the box on the form. Sign the declaration and add the place and date. Attach self-attested copies of the certificates that prove your educational qualification and age. Hand in the application, or send it by post, to the Office of the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, 5th Floor, Arogya Bhavan Building, near Ayurveda College, Thiruvananthapuram-695001. It must arrive by 5:00 PM on 7 November 2026. Applications sent by email are not accepted. Come to the interview on 11 November 2026 at 10:00 AM with your original certificates. For questions, phone the office on 04712339552 or email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Where will the Yoga Instructor work?
faq.answer: At the AYUSH Health and Wellness Centres that National AYUSH Mission runs in Thiruvananthapuram district.

faq.question: Q2. Can I email my application?
faq.answer: No. The notice says email applications are not accepted. Deliver the form in person or send it by post to the District Programme Manager's office on the 5th Floor of Arogya Bhavan, near Ayurveda College, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q3. Is a one-year yoga certificate enough to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The accepted qualifications include an approved one-year Certificate Course in Yoga from a recognized university or government department, and a Certificate Course in Yoga of one year's duration.

faq.question: Q4. Can a BAMS or BNYS graduate apply?
faq.answer: Yes. BNYS and BAMS are both on the list, along with M.Sc (Yoga) and M.Phil (Yoga).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: You must not be older than 50 years on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Will I get an interview call letter?
faq.answer: No. The interview date and time are given in the notice, so the office will not send a separate letter. Applicants must come on 11 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Possibly. The notice says a written test may be held along with the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which originals should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the original certificates that prove your educational qualification and your age. Self-attested copies of the same certificates go with the application.

faq.question: Q9. Which office can I contact?
faq.answer: The District Programme Manager's office of National AYUSH Mission, Thiruvananthapuram. Phone 04712339552 or email [email protected].
